opportunities.point: The company maintains its top-line revenue target of INR 3,500 crores for the current year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects volume growth between 30% to 40% and value growth between 50% to 60% compared to last year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Shanti Gold successfully commenced operations at its new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company allocated INR 47 crores in capex for its upcoming Jaipur facility, which is scheduled to be operational around November or December.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand alongside rising disposable incomes.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company experienced strong demand across both export and local markets following recent industry exhibitions.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility currently stands at 75%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "It's currently right now 75%." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Designer and designer-studded jewellery accounts for 75% of total revenue, while plain gold jewellery represents 25%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "75% of the revenue is from our designer jewellery and 25% from plain gold jewellery." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The Jaipur manufacturing facility is expected to become operational around mid-November or December.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: The company aims to achieve 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth during the current year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [FY27]

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.46 pp, DII -2.37 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Operating cash flow remains negative as the company maintains readily available inventory rather than operating on a strict order-to-order model.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily. We don't deal on order-to-order basis." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Management noted that geopolitical situations and wars, such as involving Iran, have caused delays in the incorporation timeline of the Dubai subsidiary.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S22/W14/O28/T16), led by 'The company maintains its top-line revenue target of INR 3,500 crores for the current year', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
